49 // One row of the ISO 3166-1 table.
50 struct iso3166_row {
51 std::string_view alpha2; // two capitals
52 std::string_view alpha3; // three capitals
53 std::uint16_t numeric; // 1 to 899
54 std::string_view name; // CLDR's English name
55 std::span<const std::string_view> currencies; // ISO 4217 codes in use (SIX list one, no funds), sorted
56 std::uint16_t calling_code; // the E.164 country calling code, 0 where none is assigned
57 };
